message.text: Let me look through the repository to find where memo deletion is handled in the store layer.
Ripgrep isn't found in the shell, and the Grep tool is also returning an error, so I should double-check what's going on there.

I want to check store.DeleteMemo in store/memo.go and its database-specific implementations to see what related data gets cleaned up before the memo row itself is deleted.The grep tool isn't working either, so I'll switch to reading the files directly instead.

This is just the raw DB delete for the memo table itself, with no cascading logic. That means the cascading deletion must live in the store wrapper layer rather than the db driver, so I should check store/memo.go next.

I found it - store.DeleteMemo removes memo_relation records where the memo is either the source or target, plus deletes any attachments linked to the memo via ListAttachments and DeleteAttachment, before finally removing the memo row itself. I should also check store/attachment.go to see if DeleteAttachment cascades to delete anything else, like storage objects.
